scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_EVENTS --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_EVENTS --remote --env production
scripts.db:generate: drizzle-kit generate --config drizzle.control.config.ts --name "${NAME:-change}" && drizzle-kit generate --config drizzle.events.config.ts --name "${NAME:-change}"
